'''CC-9002''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Manual" /> Created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the genetic template of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Databank" /> CC-9002 was a rookie [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. As a newly assigned [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]], they were given a manual with a letter from [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. Using the information in the manual, CC-9002 rose through the [[Military rank/Legends|ranks]] and became a [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]].<ref name="Manual" />

==Behind the scenes==
CC-9002 was featured in the [[Clone Commander Manual]], published in [[2009]] by the [[Penguin Books|Penguin Group]]. The manual features a letter written by Mace Windu, addressing the reader as a rookie clone working towards the rank of commander. The manual provides an identification card, which identifies the reader as CC-9002 and allows them to add their own photo to the card.<ref name="Manual" />
